LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_AegisDrained.label: (Raven) Drained Dry (Mechanical Angel)
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_AegisDrained.description: Has been subjected to high-intensity "lust-energy charging" by a mechanical angel.\n\nThe perfectly simulated slick mucous membranes, the snug-fitting flesh walls, the terrifying internal vacuum-suction mechanism, and the rhythmically vibrating micro-gears... this weaponized body rebuilt specifically for milking mercilessly drains the last drop of fluid from its master. Though the legs are too weak to stand and the mind has gone blank from forced climax, the heavenly afterglow makes it completely irresistible.
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_AegisPanacea.label: (Raven) Angel's Secret Elixir
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_AegisPanacea.description: The mechanical angel straddles the wound directly and injects refined pure "lust-energy elixir" into their body.\n\nThis exotic-scented, scalding liquid surges through their bloodstream, rebuilding damaged cells at a visible pace. Though fatal wounds heal instantly, the recipient's mind is already completely consumed by intense pleasure and aphrodisiac substances. Every cell in their body craves another dose of that lewd machine's blessing.
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_AegisRampage.label: (Raven) Lust Rampage
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_AegisRampage.description: Critically low lust energy has caused core protocol collapse; Aegis has entered an uncontrollable forced-extraction state. She will ignore all commands until the target is completely drained or her own lust energy is satisfied.
